description: Property Code-Violation & Lien History (Open-Data Cities) — Before buying, leasing or insuring a US property, reads the city's own open-data code-enforcement records for one address (or a NYC BBL/BIN) and returns normalized violations with date opened, category, description, open/closed status, source severity class and record URL; deterministic counts by status, category and year; days since the latest violation; the longest repeat-citation streak (citati

address.description: US street address with city and state, e.g. '447 21st Ave, San Francisco, CA 94121'. Give exactly one of address, bbl or bin.

city.description: City, when not inside address. For NYC a borough name (Brooklyn, Queens, ...) narrows the match.

state.description: Two-letter state, when not inside address.

zip.description: ZIP code (informational; not used to widen a match).

name: property-violations-history
